_format: Scars accumulate when a patient breaks your composure (Composure → 0 during an intake). Each scar persists for the rest of the run, applied at the start of every subsequent intake. 3 scars = file closes (run over). When a patient breaks you, a scar is rolled from the appropriate pool (by what kind of intent broke you). Each scar carries narrative weight and a real penalty. The `cleanse` approach suspends a scar for one intake.

the_name.name: The name
the_name.voice: A name they gave me sits behind my eyes. It is not a name I know.
the_name.effect: -1 Pages on the first turn of every intake.

carries_quiet.name: Carries quiet
carries_quiet.voice: I have stopped saying ~~certain~~ some words. I cannot hear them well either.

answer_you_owe.name: An answer you owe
answer_you_owe.voice: A patient is still waiting on the answer I did not give.

wears_my_hand.name: Wears my hand
wears_my_hand.voice: There is the warmth of a hand on mine. It is mine. !!It is also not.!!

knows_my_voice.name: Knows my voice
knows_my_voice.voice: Something can speak in my voice now. ~~I hear it when I sleep.~~ I do not sleep.

small_smile.name: Small smile
small_smile.voice: I have caught myself smiling at the wrong moments. The mirror has been ~~moved~~ turned.

closed_wound.name: A wound that closed wrong
closed_wound.voice: It does not bleed. It does not open. It does not ~~heal~~ leave.

wrist_bruise.name: Wrist bruise
wrist_bruise.voice: I held something I should not have held. The mark stayed.

stooped.name: Stooped
stooped.voice: I do not stand as straight. The room is shorter than I remember.

corner_behind.name: Corner behind me
corner_behind.voice: I keep checking it. The check is the trouble.
corner_behind.effect: -1 Insight at the start of every intake.

third_eye_open.name: A third eye, opened
third_eye_open.voice: It does not close. It does not blink. The light is the trouble.

draughty.name: Draughty
draughty.voice: There is a draught I cannot find the source of. ~~It speaks.~~ It is the room.

wrong_drawer.name: Wrong drawer
wrong_drawer.voice: I filed something in the wrong drawer. The drawer is not in the building anymore.

page_torn.name: Page torn
page_torn.voice: A page of mine is missing. !!I do not know which.!!

loose_signature.name: Loose signature
loose_signature.voice: I sign in a hand that is mostly mine. The other hand is ~~learning~~ practising.
